title: Director's Vision vs. State Censorship
grammar: Subjunctive in indirect directives and elliptical warnings
goal: I can explain how directors used classic plays to speak between the lines under the 'three T' cultural policy.
I can use hogy and nehogy + subjunctive after verbs of warning and effect (figyelmeztet, elér).
I can talk about directors, censors and the stage in a short text.
